en: The postcard shows a black and white photograph of a group of people, including children and adults, gathered at a water fountain or spring set against a rocky or clay hillside. Jugs are visible, indicating they are collecting water. The setting appears rustic and historical. The text includes '160. SALONIQUE', along with publisher information 'Edit. Rollier, Lyon'. There is a circular seal on the left and the watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' over the image.
